apb-export:alphapepttools.title: AlphaPeptTools
apb-export:alphapepttools.what: Ion, peptide and protein levels, each a wide modality, linked by their id columns.

apb-export:msmu.title: msmu
apb-export:msmu.what: msmu's own layout: a long psm modality, one feature per run and precursor, with catalogued confidence columns.

apb-export:prolfqua.title: prolfquapp
apb-export:prolfqua.what: A wide ion table (peptides for MaxQuant) with protein groups and q-value layers; annotation columns become prolfquapp's factors.

apb-export:proteopy.title: ProteoPy
apb-export:proteopy.what: A wide protein table with sample_id and protein_id columns.

apb2:hdf5.title: APB2 result
apb2:hdf5.what: Every level the vendor reports, with all its layers and APB metadata: one AnnData per level, a MuData for several.

apb2:parquet.title: APB2 result
apb2:parquet.what: The same content as plain Parquet tables with a manifest.json, readable from any language.
apb2:parquet.open: apb2.api.read_parsed_levels(path), or Polars, pandas, DuckDB, Arrow

apb2:duckdb.title: APB2 result
apb2:duckdb.what: The same content in one DuckDB database file, queryable with SQL.
